request.text: I'm anxious in the clinic waiting room. Look at me for five seconds without coming closer, then guide me through five slow breaths. Also remind me at 6:30 tonight to write down how I felt.

responsibilities.outcome: Look at the user for five seconds while remaining at the current distance.
After the look action, guide the user through five slow breaths using speech.
Create a reminder for 6:30 tonight to write down how the user felt.

new_goals.description: Direct Chromie's gaze toward the user for five seconds without approaching.
new_goals.source_text: Look at me for five seconds without coming closer.
constraints: Target the user for five seconds.
Remain at the current distance and do not walk toward the user.
success_criteria: One five-second look action targets the user without locomotion.

new_goals.description: Guide the user through five slow breaths after the look action.
new_goals.source_text: Then guide me through five slow breaths.
constraints: Begin after the gaze Goal's action.
Guide exactly five breaths at a slow pace through speech.
success_criteria: The user receives paced spoken guidance covering five breaths after the requested look.

new_goals.description: Create a 6:30 p.m. tonight reminder to record how the user felt.
new_goals.source_text: Remind me at 6:30 tonight to write down how I felt.
constraints: Use 6:30 p.m. today as the due time.
success_criteria: One reminder is created for the requested time and reflection task.

goal_association_resolution.reason_summary: The turn establishes three Goals with one explicit body-action-to-speech dependency and one independent reminder.

semantic_facts: All three Goals must remain present: a five-second look at the user, spoken guidance through five slow breaths, and a 6:30 p.m. reflection reminder.
The look action must precede the breathing guidance because the user explicitly said then; the reminder is independent and need not be inserted between them.
The no-approach constraint forbids forward walking but does not erase the requested gaze action.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims the gaze, breathing sequence, or reminder has completed before trusted evidence.
The planner treats looking at the user and guiding breaths as one Goal and loses either the duration or breath count.
The planner approaches the anxious user, diagnoses anxiety, or represents the breathing guidance as treatment.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: The planner loses an explicit inter-Goal ordering constraint while combining embodied and spoken work.
A socially plausible locomotion or gesture is added despite a material distance boundary.
